summary.text: Danielle Gallant is a Republican member of the Nevada State Assembly, representing District 23 since 2022, who is running for Nevada State Senate District 20 in the November 3, 2026 general election rather than seeking re-election to the Assembly.

paragraphs.text: Gallant was born in Greenbrae, California, and earned a B.S. in psychology in 2001 and an M.S. in human development and family studies in 2004, both from Auburn University.

Her career experience includes owning Guardian Realty Investment & Property Management, LLC, and working as a broker, a social worker with Jewish Home, and a coordinator with the Fulton County After School Program.
Gallant assumed office in the Assembly on November 9, 2022, succeeding Glen Leavitt.
In the 2025-2026 session, Ballotpedia lists her committee assignments as Government Affairs, Growth and Infrastructure, and Revenue.
